scope: Adjudicate the residual failure-injection plan without changing, promoting, or transferring qualification from the exact hosted-passed content-admission subject that is awaiting central A-01 registration.

RF012.case: approved author-decision reference belongs to a different content subject than the operation being admitted
RF012.contract_requirement: A previously committed AUTHOR_DECISION is immutable history, but every consumer must independently test whether it is current and applicable to its exact subject before acting. Resolution/request evidence is bound to exact decision-request and subject identities.
RF012.observed_implementation_behavior: assertAuthorDecision currently accepts any referenced parent AUTHOR_DECISION whose decision_id resolves, status is APPROVED, and author_choice is affirmative. The check does not compare the decision subject_ref or exact subject identity to the content object/unit operation being admitted.
RF012.risk: A valid approval for subject A can be replayed as the author-decision precondition for subject B if the caller supplies its decision_id.
RF012.repair_boundary: Strengthen the content-admission consumer only. Do not modify the canonical AUTHOR_DECISION schema, author-decision queue authority, lifecycle authority, publication authority, or the already-hosted-passed A-01 candidate in place.
RF012.minimum_required_test: Construct two distinct exact content subjects; bind an APPROVED AUTHOR_DECISION to subject A; attempt an operation on subject B with requires_author_decision=true and author_decision_refs containing A; require deterministic fail-closed rejection with zero parent-state mutation and zero successful receipt. A correctly bound same-subject control case must still pass.

other_residual_cases.rule: RF001-RF011 and RF013-RF016 remain adversarial regression targets. Their existence does not authorize speculative implementation changes before a failing test demonstrates a contract gap.

exact_sha_law.derivative_rule: Any code or executable-test change creates a new exact subject SHA. The derivative must receive fresh focused and full hosted qualification. No PASS may transfer from e993806a1d9a4838d4bd6d162a36921526ef302a. Central A-01 authority must separately decide whether to continue with the original subject or register the repaired derivative after hosted qualification.

required_outputs: minimal content-admission subject-applicability check for referenced AUTHOR_DECISION evidence
RF012 negative fixture proving cross-subject decision replay is rejected
full existing content-admission and Version/Rollback regression suite
fresh exact derivative SHA and hosted evidence record
forbidden_outputs: fabricated author choice or author authority proof
mutation of the original exact A-01 candidate in place
claim that hosted PASS is A-01 PASS
publication, provider, Prose, native or production authority expansion

completion_delta: Residual design was converted into an evidence-backed derivative decision. RF012 is no longer an unanswered question: the Author Decision Queue contract requires exact subject applicability while the current consumer checks approval status/choice only. The original A-01 candidate remains preserved, and a bounded repaired derivative with fresh qualification is now the executable successor.
stop_condition: SATISFIED for residual derivative adjudication only. Executable RF012 repair and fresh qualification remain open.
